js: 'SETUP: as chat-folders.json (a dev instance with the fake-echo alias); scripts/chat-drives.sh --only chat-live runs it. Wipes every chat thread and folder of that instance first. The Chat page follows what a paired device writes (client-apps design §3.6, 2026-10-08): the device writes through its own key, never the page, so only /api/events can tell the page; the page is never reloaded meanwhile. A tall turn the device adds follows a reader at the end of the transcript and leaves one who scrolled up (review CL-1); a device turn moves its conversation up the list and only that row is read (CL-11); the open thread deleted under a draft leaves the draft in an unsaved new chat, and nothing is made, nor the ongoing folder\'s current thread moved, until Send (CL-2, CL-14); a second Enter while Send makes the new chat neither makes nor opens it twice, and a Send after a failed open reads the chat first and keeps the draft once another writer wrote in it (CL-19); opening another conversation while Send makes the chat leaves it there, unopened and unsent into (CL-20); a draft waiting in an ongoing folder holds the picker on the folder\'s model, says why, and writes no model, so the folder\'s current thread keeps it (CF-2); a model picked while the draft waits in a plain folder that names one is the new chat\'s (CL-21); an open or a New chat that left the draft and failed (a 500, a 404, the toolbar\'s and the folder menu\'s New chat) puts its new chat back, and Send while that open is out says so (CF-1); the fall-through after a delete elsewhere and New chat\'s open never override a conversation the owner clicked meanwhile, and a failed New chat cancels no open (CF-4); leaving the page drops such a draft. From step 08 on, the page\'s own requests are logged, and chosen answers held or failed, by a wrapper around window.fetch. Keep on a temporary chat opens the kept chat although the open row was clicked meanwhile, a search hit\'s reveal superseded by another open leaves no "that message no longer exists" note, and Retry on a failed list read keeps a waiting draft waiting (CF-10, CF-5, CF-9).'

js: (()=>{const of=window.fetch;window.__log=[];window.__hold={};window.__late={};window.__fail={};window.fetch=async function(u,o){if(typeof u==='string')return of.apply(this,arguments);const k=u.method.toUpperCase()+' '+new URL(u.url).pathname;window.__log.push(k);for(const re of Object.keys(window.__fail)){if(new RegExp(re).test(k)){const f=window.__fail[re];delete window.__fail[re];const st=typeof f==='object'?f.status:(f>=400?f:500);if(typeof f==='object'&&f.ms)await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,f.ms));return new Response(JSON.stringify(st===404?{code:'not_found',message:'the drive says this conversation is not there'}:{code:'internal',message:'the drive fails this read'}),{status:st,headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}})}}for(const [re,ms] of Object.entries(window.__late)){if(new RegExp(re).test(k)){await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,ms));break}}for(const [re,ms] of Object.entries(window.__hold)){if(new RegExp(re).test(k)){const r=await of.apply(this,arguments);await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,ms));return r}}return of.apply(this,arguments)};window.__made=()=>__cur();window.__thread=id=>fetch('/chat/api/threads/'+id).then(r=>r.json());return 'the page\'s own requests (gloo-net passes a Request; the drive\'s own calls pass a URL) are logged in __log; __hold delays an answer, __late delays a request before it goes out, __fail fails one (a status: 404 is not_found, else a 500; or {status, ms}: that late)'})()
